caption: The drawing depicts two identical figurines of animals, each positioned on a separate rectangular base with rounded edges. The animals are depicted as having thick, gray bodies covered in small, evenly spaced, raised dots. Each animal’s face is pale with prominent, dark, wide-set eyes, and short, pointed ears. Their limbs are tucked closely underneath their bodies, and their short tails are visible on the right side of each figure. Both animals are oriented to the right, side by side, occupying the horizontal center of the composition. The bases they rest upon are rendered in shades of brown and green, with some shading to suggest depth. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned, with no other details besides the two figurines situated centrally on the page. There is a small handwritten inscription in the lower right area next to the right figurine.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Sheep
